verdict.summary: Round 3 resolves the prior major finding. The classifier now recognizes method-less `gh api` label calls as writes when field/input flags trigger GitHub CLI's implicit POST, while explicit GET/HEAD remains read-only. The positive fixtures exercise both implicit-POST and explicit-method writes with foreign credentials, and the negative fixture covers genuine label reads, including a fielded explicit GET. The self-test passes with 6 positive and 7 negative cases, and the repository enforcement scan passes. No correctness, security, or vacuity issue remains in the diff-scoped change.
